articles.title: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year
articles.snippet: The payments giant is planning a major global expansion for its stablecoin cards business, and is exploring tokenized deposits and DeFi use cases, new crypto head Henri Stern said.

articles.title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
articles.snippet: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.

articles.title: Russia’s digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
articles.snippet: The digital ruble’s early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.

articles.title: Bryan Johnson Spent Millions to Reverse Aging. He Says a Filter Works Better
articles.snippet: The face of the "Don't Die" movement now says retouching beats therapy for looking young. His transformation over the summer may explain why.

articles.title: 'We Have Identified You, Sir': Near Intents Recovers $3.8 Million After 48-Hour Ultimatum
articles.snippet: Near Intents said the roughly $3.8 million drained in an exploit on Thursday was returned in full, a day after the team said it had identified the attacker and gave them 48 hours to return the funds.
